en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view over a coastal city with early‑20th‑century European buildings, a small square or park with trees in the foreground, and a harbor with ships and a hilly headland in the background. On the right are ornate multi‑story facades with rooftop statues. The bottom left text is in Cyrillic, and the bottom right text in French reads "Vue de Varna."
